snippet.title: Eufloria 2 Reveal Trailer - Intergalactic floral conquest has EVOLVED!
snippet.description:
Wishlist - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4415060/Eufloria_2?utm_source=youtube
Discord - https://discord.com/invite/unsbgkR23z

Eufloria 2 expands and improves the original’s Bafta and IGF nominated unique approach to RTS and 4X gameplay.

Intergalactic floral conquest and lush procedural environments are infused with deep eco-system-inspired gameplay additions. 

Experience a unique blend of strategy, 4x and cozy sim gameplay. Conquer asteroids in space and use their resources to grow custom floral creatures that do your bidding. Expand your empire and fight against several teams of opponents that all vie for the same resources and can offer fierce opposition. 

Eufloria 2 ups the ante by introducing evolution and ecosystem-based gameplay, handing players the power to strongly influence evolutionary processes, and to construct entirely new strains of life. Player-controlled mutation and evolution of their units unlocks vast, new gameplay opportunities with emergent properties.

Procedural environments and life forms guarantee replayability and cater to a wide range of gameplay styles, including:
- Strategic challenges
- Explorative and experimental gameplay
- “Ambient”, cozy experiences
- Lore-filled campaign with short and long term missions
- Mode-based game variations

Crucially, Eufloria 2 will be highly moddable with a powerful Godot-based editor, guaranteeing frequent new content.


While retaining the original’s charm and floral aesthetic, Eufloria 2 will feature innovative new gameplay and features, including
- Lore expanding campaign mode
- Cozy AND deep gameplay
- New evolution-based mechanics
- Ecosystem manipulation
- Creative, impactful unit customisation
- Ancient artifact powers
- Major interface improvements
- New game modes
- Modding support with a powerful editor
- Greatly improved, lusher procedural visuals
- And much much more

Eufloria 2 is now in active development, with a community-focused open development approach.

Wishlist now for frequent development updates and access to exclusive closed tests!

Better yet, join our friendly Discord community and be part of the journey.

#Eufloria #Eufloria2 #Gameplay
